def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - item
    overflow_penalty = np.where(remaining < 0, -1e6, 0)
    target_fill_ratio = 0.7
    target_capacity = bins * target_fill_ratio
    fill_deviation = -np.abs((bins - remaining) - target_capacity)
    capacity_reward = remaining * 0.1
    scores = overflow_penalty + fill_deviation + capacity_reward
    return scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - item
    valid = remaining >= 0
    utilization_ratio = (bins - remaining) / bins if (bins > 0).any() else np.zeros_like(bins)
    ideal_utilization = 0.5  # Target midpoint for balanced utilization
    scores = -np.abs(utilization_ratio - ideal_utilization)
    scores = np.where(valid, scores, -1e6)
    return scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    avg_capacity = np.mean(bins)
    remaining = bins - np.min(bins)
    # Normalize remaining capacity relative to average
    normalized_remaining = remaining / (avg_capacity + 1e-8)
    # Penalize bins near average capacity to promote balance
    deviation_from_avg = np.abs(bins - avg_capacity)
    balance_factor = 1 / (deviation_from_avg + 1e-8)
    # Combine remaining capacity and balance factor, only if item fits
    priority_scores = np.where(remaining >= item, normalized_remaining * balance_factor, 0)
    return priority_scores

    valid = remaining >= 0
    avg_remaining = np.mean(remaining[valid]) if np.any(valid) else 0
    scores = -np.abs(remaining - avg_remaining)
    scores = np.where(valid, scores, -1e6)

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - item
    valid = remaining >= 0
    median_remaining = np.median(remaining[valid]) if np.any(valid) else 0
    scores = -np.abs(remaining - median_remaining)
    scores = np.where(valid, scores, -1e6)
    return scores
